doc.title: Herbie Hancock interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, November 18, 1995

title: Closing remarks
summary: Woods thanks him and hopes for a second interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And I can also see how your music would be at the spearhead of that. Listen we’ve got to let you go because you’ve got to play tonight. This has been wonderful. Monk, can I put a plug in here and say can we do round two sometime? Because he’s not even started, he’s not even warmed up yet. But we’re filming for Hamilton College Jazz Archives. We have been with one of the icons of this country in music, Herbie Hancock. Thank you.
